clinical_summary.finding: Suspicious right upper lobe pulmonary nodule

recommendation.reason: The submitted documentation supports tissue sampling of a suspicious right upper lobe pulmonary nodule. Robotic navigational bronchoscopy suits the lesion because it is a peripheral RUL posterior-segment nodule reachable through patent airways. It suits the patient because she has moderate COPD with emphysema (FEV1 62% predicted), which makes the higher pneumothorax risk of CT-guided transthoracic biopsy less desirable.
